This '''individual''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Customs Inspector|customs inspector]] who served aboard [[Skifter Station]] in orbit around the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuratooine]].<ref name="Mercy Kill" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> the inspector's [[Unidentified Mon Calamari customs inspector|partner]], a female [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] customs inspector, inspected the false identities of [[Wraith Squadron]] members [[Myri Antilles]] and [[Turman Durra]], a [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit. After scanning Durra's disguised palm print and confirming that no contraband was aboard their [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], she informed the pair that they would be permitted to enter Kuratooine once they had paid their visa fees before the two inspectors proceed to inspect the next arriving spacecraft.<ref name="Mercy Kill" />
